summary: Iteration 2 backend validation: 39/39 pytest tests pass. Added 11 new tests covering (a) streaming/chunked upload correctness with storage_used increment, (b) incremental 2GB storage enforcement (simulated by pre-seeding storage_used to MAX-1KB, then uploading 4KB which is correctly rejected with 400 'Storage limit exceeded'), (c) Stripe webhook signature verification (both missing Stripe-Signature and bogus signature return 400), (d) activate_plan_from_transaction idempotency (first paid call activates + returns True, second call returns False, plan/expiry not double-set; non-paid input returns False), (e) YouTube not-configured paths: GET /api/youtube/status -> {configured:false, connected:false}, GET /api/youtube/oauth/authorize -> 503 with 'not configured' detail, POST /api/youtube/broadcast/create -> 403 gatekeep for no-plan user and 400 'Connect your YouTube channel first.' when admin (active plan) has no youtube_accounts record. All 28 iteration-1 regressions still pass (auth, gatekeeping, videos CRUD/rename/delete + storage decrement, live-slot start/stop/settings, Stripe checkout session + status, billings, support, dashboard stats).

minor.issue: Redirects to /dashboard/live-slot?youtube=error when code/state missing, but the base_url comes from request.base_url which behind the ingress may not be the public preview URL; consider using PUBLIC_APP_URL env for the final RedirectResponse.

start_ffmpeg_push is invoked before verifying that the ffmpeg binary is usable or that the video codec is compatible; a failure inside subprocess.Popen would raise 500 but leave the broadcast created on YouTube without ffmpeg attached. Consider wrapping in try/except and rolling back / transitioning broadcast to 'complete' on failure.
ffmpeg_pid is stored but there is no health check that ffmpeg is still alive; consumers of /api/live-slot may see is_live=true while ffmpeg has already exited.

Now enforces signature verification via emergentintegrations.handle_webhook (good). Note: any HTTPException other than 400 raised inside the helper would still bubble; error path only logs and returns 400 — acceptable, but consider logging body length + event type on failure for debuggability.

activate_plan_from_transaction is idempotent, but /api/payments/checkout-status still returns the ORIGINAL transaction dict fetched before activation (fields patched only in-memory when activated in this call). If webhook activates first, poll will re-fetch and see 'completed' correctly — behavior is correct, just noting the in-memory patch is a bit fragile.

action_items: (Optional) Harden /api/youtube/broadcast/create to transition the broadcast to 'complete' if ffmpeg fails to start, so half-created broadcasts don't linger on the channel.
(Optional) Add a lightweight ffmpeg liveness check (os.kill(pid, 0)) inside /api/live-slot so is_live reflects reality.
(Optional) Split server.py into routers (auth/videos/payments/youtube/live_slot) - file is now ~1000 lines.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1009 lines — recommend splitting into APIRouter modules per feature (auth, videos, payments, youtube, live_slot, billings, support, dashboard).
Streaming upload correctly uses 1MB chunks with incremental remaining_budget guard and cleans up partial files on abort — good.
activate_plan_from_transaction uses an atomic conditional update ({'status': {'$ne':'completed'}}) with modified_count==0 short-circuit — solid idempotency guarantee against webhook/polling race.
Stripe webhook now returns 400 on ANY exception from stripe_checkout.handle_webhook including missing signature — behavior matches spec.
youtube_service.is_configured() correctly returns False when either env var is empty, guarding both /status and /authorize paths.
YouTubeAccounts collection has no unique index on user_id — upsert prevents duplicates but a schema index would be defensive.
start_ffmpeg_push logs stream_key prefix in server log — good OpSec, but the log file at /tmp/ffmpeg_{stream_key[:8]}.log has the full stream key implicit in its name path; consider hashing.
on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI — migrate to lifespan handler.
test_credentials.md is overwritten on every backend startup (unchanged from iter 1).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@liveadda.com / admin123 (monthly plan seeded on startup). Fresh users generated per-test with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: TestIdempotentActivation creates+cleans a synthetic TEST_idem_user_* + payment_transactions doc directly via pymongo. TestStorageEnforcement temporarily rewrites admin's storage_used to MAX-1KB and restores original value in finally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend now has YouTube endpoints under /api/youtube/*. YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET are intentionally empty in /app/backend/.env - tests validate the not-configured path only (do NOT attempt real OAuth). To test with real credentials, set both env vars, restart backend, and youtube_service.is_configured() will return True, changing /api/youtube/status and /api/youtube/oauth/authorize behavior. Streaming upload validated with a 16KB payload; incremental limit validated by pre-seeding storage_used - do NOT attempt an actual 2GB upload over the preview URL. Stripe webhook signature verification is delegated to emergentintegrations.handle_webhook — any missing/bad Stripe-Signature yields 400. activate_plan_from_transaction is atomic via conditional Mongo update; safe against webhook+polling races. server.py is now 1009 lines - consider suggesting a refactor.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in iteration 2. All three new features (streaming upload, hardened Stripe webhook, YouTube integration scaffolding) behave per spec on the not-configured / correctness paths validated.
